text: The prince was standing in the blue room, and his voice rang loudly and clearly through all seven rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> A few courtiers moved toward the stranger, but a strange fear stopped them, and no one put out a hand to seize him. <break time="0.8s" /> With slow, solemn steps, the figure walked past the prince and through the blue, purple, green, orange, white, and violet rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> Angry and ashamed of his own fear, the prince rushed through the six rooms with a dagger, but no one followed him. <break time="0.8s" /> When the figure reached the far end of the black room, it suddenly turned and faced the prince. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a sharp cry, the dagger fell onto the black carpet, and a moment later Prince Prospero fell there lifeless. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the guests, with the wild courage of despair, rushed into the black room and seized the figure standing by the ebony clock. <break time="0.8s" /> To their horror, they found that there was nothing at all inside the grave clothes and the mask. <break time="0.8s" /> Now they knew that it was the Red Death itself that had come, like a thief in the night. <break time="0.8s" /> One by one the guests fell in the halls of their party, the ebony clock stopped, the fires went out, and Darkness, Decay, and the Red Death ruled over all.
